title: She Fell In Love With A Wolf, And Raised His Two Wolf Children Alone . . .
caption:
In Wolf Children (2012), Hana finds the man she loves, the last wolf man, dead in a drain on a rainy day.
So she raises his two wolf kids alone in the mountains, until each one must choose: human or wolf.

#wolfchildren #anime #animerecap #animemovie #recap
comment: Would you have let Ame run up the mountain, or kept him home? Why?

segments.say: Hana's husband was a wolf, and one rainy night, she found him dead in a *drain*.
To see how it got here, go back to a quiet lecture *hall*, years earlier.
Hana is a poor student, juggling jobs just to pay for *school*.
Then one day, she spots a stranger in the back row, taking notes without a *textbook*.
He is not even a student here, but Hana offers to share her notes, and he *stays*.
Soon they are *inseparable*, sharing lectures, books, and sunsets.
But one night, he says he has a *secret*.
He asks her to look, and the man turns into a *wolf*.
Hana is not scared. Most people would have run. She did *not*.
So he moves in, drives a delivery truck, and for the first time, the last of his kind has a *home*.
That winter, Yuki is born in a snowstorm, and the next spring, Hana is expecting *again*.
On the rainy day Ame arrives, her husband steps out and never comes back, so Hana heads into the rain to *find* him.
And there, lying in a drain, is the man she loved, gone like a stray *animal*.
In her mind, she hears him whisper, take good care of our *children*.
All he left behind was an old ID card, two wolf babies, and one very tired *mother*.
Yuki turns into a wolf pup whenever she is cranky, and she is cranky a *lot*.
There is no book for raising wolf babies, so she tries a pediatrics one and hopes for the *best*.
Ame cries all night, and Hana cannot sleep, cannot study, cannot *rest*.
When they get sick, she cannot take them to a doctor, or a *vet*.
Then the neighbors complain about the noise, and child welfare *knocks*.
So one day, she takes her kids to an empty field and asks, do you want to be people, or *wolves*?
Then she moves them far away, to an old house in the mountains, where nobody will pry into their *lives*.
The house is a wreck, but the kids love the *yard*, and Hana scrubs every floor herself.
She makes one rule. Being wolf children is their little *secret*.
Then the farming goes badly. Her tomatoes die, and the old farmer next door says her smile makes her look like a damn *fool*.
But grumpy Nirasaki keeps showing up, bossing her around, until she learns to dig, plant, and *grow*.
Soon the whole village pitches in, and by fall, she has more potatoes than three people can possibly *eat*.
Then winter comes, and Yuki and Ame race through the snow as wolves, with Hana laughing right behind *them*.
But then the icy river pulls Ame *under*.
Hana drags him out, and he is not moving. She screams at him to open his *eyes*.
Ame is fine. He was too busy bragging about the bird he *caught*.
Years pass, and Yuki starts school, with Hana beaming from the back of the *crowd*.
Hana takes little Ame to meet a real wolf, but the old guy was raised in a zoo, and he has nothing to *teach*.
Over at school, Yuki just wants to fit in, but she collects snakes and animal bones. Not exactly normal girl *stuff*.
So she decides to be a perfect lady, and her mom sews her a brand new *dress*.
Then a new boy named Sohei sniffs at her and says she smells like a *dog*.
Rude. But also, *accurate*.
When he keeps pushing, the wolf inside Yuki snaps, and Sohei ends up with a *bloody* ear.
Hana rushes to the school, but Yuki will not say a single *word*.
His mother threatens to sue, but Sohei jumps in. A wolf did it, he says, and nobody *believes* him.
Even so, Sohei keeps coming by with Yuki's homework, and he says wolves are pretty *cool*.
Meanwhile, Ame wants nothing to do with school. He spends his days on the mountain with a wise old fox he calls *Sensei*.
At dinner, Yuki begs him to try school just *once*.

segments.text: Because I'm a wolf. You are a human. No, I'm not.

segments.say: The argument gets out of hand, and two wolf kids tear the kitchen *apart*. Sibling rivalry, wolf edition.
Then record storms hit, and a drenched Ame keeps coming home from the *mountain*.
Sensei is dying, Ame says, and somebody has to take his place. Hana begs him to *stay*.
The next day, Yuki goes to school despite the forecast, and by afternoon, the storm is so bad that everyone is sent home *early*.
At home, Hana gets the call to pick up Yuki, and when she turns around, Ame is *gone*.
So she pulls on her yellow raincoat, and runs into the storm *alone*.
At school, the parents rush in one by one, until only Yuki and Sohei are *left*.
Deep in the forest, Hana hears something huge moving in the fog, and then the ground gives *way*.
She slides down the hillside, and is knocked out cold in the *mud*.
Back at school, Sohei admits he feels forgotten now that his mom is having a baby, so Yuki tells him the secret she has kept for *years*.
Her ears pop out, and Sohei just *smiles*. He knew all along.
Meanwhile, Hana lies in the mud, and in her dream, she sees *him*.
He holds her, says sorry for leaving, and says he watched over them the whole *time*.
She wakes up in the rain, and a full grown wolf is standing over her. It is *Ame*.
He turns and runs up the mountain, and Hana screams after him to *wait*.
From a cliff above the waterfall, Ame howls at the sunrise, and Hana smiles through her *tears*.
Letting him go was the bravest thing she ever *did*.
A year later, Yuki leaves for boarding school, and Hana stays behind in the old *house*.
She lives there alone, but happy, and her son guards the mountain now, always *watching*.
